content:
Product and Integration Developments

In the AI ecosystem, integration and new product launches accelerated this week. Apple stated that while preparing to introduce the new Gemini-powered Siri in February, it will use a private cloud infrastructure for the security of user data. Meanwhile, OpenAI announced the LaTeX-based Prism tool for scientific research, and it was found that ChatGPT had started using Grokipedia data belonging to xAI.

Other key developments are as follows:

  • Anthropic: Claude started working in integration with business applications such as Slack, Figma, and Asana. However, the company faced a $3 billion copyright lawsuit by music publishers.
  • Google: While Gemini features were added to the Chrome browser, Project Genie, which enables the creation of interactive worlds, was made available.

Agentic AI and Hardware

Autonomous agents and the hardware supporting these models remain on the agenda. Microsoft introduced the Maia 200 chip to scale AI inference. Apple, on the other hand, invested in sensor-based nonverbal communication technologies by acquiring voice technology startup Q.ai for $2 billion.

  • Wonderful: The Agent Builder platform, which enables companies to create autonomous agents, was announced.
  • Clawdbot: The open-source personal AI assistant was opened to developer access.
  • Snap: It is turning its AR glasses unit into an independent company open to external investment.

New Models and Open Source

This week's model-side innovations focused especially on visual processing and coding:

  • DeepSeek: Released the OCR 2 model focused on text extraction from documents as open source.
  • Luma AI: The video generation model Ray3.14 was launched with faster processing capacity.
  • Gemini 3 Flash: The Agentic Vision capability combining visual reasoning with code execution was introduced.
  • AI2: SERA, the open-source coding agent powered by Claude Code, was announced.
  • NVIDIA: The bidirectional speech model PersonaPlex was introduced.

Investment Activity

Cash flow in the sector continues with large-scale acquisitions and investments:

  • NVIDIA: Invested $2 billion in CoreWeave.
  • Tesla: Provided $2 billion in funding to Elon Musk's xAI venture.
  • Synthesia: Received a $200 million investment at a $4 billion valuation.
  • Ricursive Intelligence: Completed a $300 million Series A funding round.
  • Microsoft: Announced that the OpenAI partnership contributed $7.6 billion to quarterly profit.
